# Rule ledger

*Generated by `scripts/build_paper_tables.py` from `docs/rule_ledger.json`. Do not edit by hand. Every value below is read from the committed artifact the ledger names, and recomputed from the per-seed list when the clause names a statistic. `python scripts/build_paper_tables.py --check` fails if a value, a recorded outcome or this page disagrees with it.*

Every frozen decision rule in this repository adjudicated at the 0.65 bar or the 0.05 margin, one row per rule and run, as recorded at the time. No rule is re-adjudicated and no threshold is changed here. Each clause names the artifact value it reads. scripts/build_paper_tables.py reads that value, recomputes it from the per-seed list when the clause names a statistic, checks it against the recorded reading and the recorded outcome, and renders docs/RULE_LEDGER.md.

44 rule-and-run rows: the threshold condition holds on 17 and fails on 20; 5 are uninformative and 2 give no verdict. "Holds" means the clauses at the bar and the margin are satisfied as frozen; for a knockout or a control whose positive rule is the reading it looked for, the outcome column says what that means.

Each clause is listed with its basis (the mean, the t-based 90% lower bound, a minimum or a rank), its recomputed value, the threshold as frozen, and the signed distance to that threshold (positive is on the passing side). Clauses marked "reported, not in the rule" are values the record quotes beside the rule's own basis, such as an interval beside a rule adjudicated on the mean; they decide nothing.

## Boundary cases (within 0.01 of a threshold)

On the rule's own basis:

- Drift-0.45 world-sample sensitivity (`L3-H8-HELDOUT`): registered draw at or below the median (rank of nine, 1 = largest) 5 >= 5, 0; the rule's clauses hold, this one exactly at the bound.
- L3 primary rule at the second capacity, hidden 7, corrected trainer (`H7-CORRECTED`): bar (t90 lower bound) 0.6496 >= 0.65, -0.0004; other clauses fail as well.
- Hidden 8 at a new surrogate seed (seed 2): replication (`L3-H8-GS2-GPU`): margin over predictor (difference of means) 0.0491 > 0.05, -0.0009; other clauses fail as well; it sets the spec's outcome row, margins fail.
- L3 primary rule at the second capacity, hidden 7, corrected trainer (`H7-CORRECTED`): gate: gate 0: untrained floor within 0.1 of 0.5 (distance of the floor from 0.5) 0.1011 < 0.1, -0.0011; other clauses fail as well.
- Second surrogate instance (seed 1, hidden 10): replication (`L3-H10-GS1-GPU`): gate: speed positive control in every pool (minimum over 60 pools) 0.748 >= 0.75, -0.0022; other clauses fail as well.
- B-v2 primary rule (H_B2), L2 rollout drift (`BV2-L2-AR1`): margin over untrained (difference of means) 0.047 >= 0.05, -0.0028; other clauses fail as well.
- Nonlinear joint input-plus-behavior control, hidden 8 (`L3-H8-HELDOUT`): bar (mean) 0.654 >= 0.65, +0.0042; the rule's clauses hold by this margin.
- Primary rule (H_B2) at L1, observation quantization (`L1-ORGANISM`): margin over predictor (difference of means) 0.045 >= 0.05, -0.005; other clauses fail as well.
- Comparator-trained run on the white-jitter family, at the registered trunk (`T-GN-H96`): margin over untrained (difference of means) 0.044 >= 0.05, -0.006; other clauses fail as well.
- Second surrogate instance (seed 1, hidden 10): replication (`L3-H10-GS1-CPU`): behavior-controlled bar (mean) 0.658 >= 0.65, +0.008; it passes while another clause fails.
- Hidden 8 at a new surrogate seed (seed 2): replication, corrected trainer (`H8GS2-CORRECTED`): bar (mean) 0.659 >= 0.65, +0.009; it passes while another clause fails.
- Comparator-trained run on the white-jitter family, at the registered trunk (`T-GN-H96`): margin over predictor (difference of means) 0.040 >= 0.05, -0.010; other clauses fail as well.

Reported values beside the rule's own basis:

- Cross-recipe transfer to the random-Fourier-features family (`L3-H8-HELDOUT`): bar (t90 lower bound) 0.654 >= 0.65, +0.0036; reported beside the rule's own basis; it decides nothing.
- Common garden, prefix in the hidden-7 surrogate (`L3-H7-REVERSE`): bar (t90 lower bound) 0.645 >= 0.65, -0.005; reported beside the rule's own basis; it decides nothing.

## Notes

- Row 1, B-v2 primary rule (H_B2), L2 rollout drift: n = 3 seeds; the run predates the t-interval adjudication of the later rungs.
- Row 2, B-v3 primary rule, L2 per-episode drag regime: The t-interval adjudication came with the B-v3 audit of 2026-07-10, after this freeze; the interval misses the bar as well.
- Row 3, L3 primary rule, historical headline at hidden 8: Legacy partition, the one the verdict used. The explicit-partition re-score of the same agents (2026-09-29) reads 0.774 [0.727, 0.821] with the L0 gate open (0.539, TOST p 0.207); no verdict was re-adjudicated.
- Row 4, L3 primary rule at the second capacity, hidden 7: The rule is from the original freeze; the hidden-7 selection itself was committed with its result (2026-07-16 entry). Misses the margin by 0.027, so it is not a boundary case.
- Row 8, Common garden, prefix in the hidden-8 surrogate: Passes on its mean basis while the t90 lower bound sits under the bar. Reads the prefix's physical footprint, not retention (FINDINGS 17.7).
- Row 10, Common garden, prefix in the hidden-7 surrogate: Passes on its mean basis while the t90 lower bound sits under the bar.
- Row 11, Cross-recipe transfer to the random-Fourier-features family: Readout-only on the saved held-out agents. The t90 lower bound clears the bar by 0.004.
- Row 12, Texture knockout: transfer to matched-band white jitter, hidden 8: A failed positive rule is the reading the knockout looked for; it establishes no learned-texture mechanism (2026-10-06 wording amendment).
- Row 13, Texture knockout: transfer to matched-band white jitter, hidden 7: A failed positive rule is the reading the knockout looked for; it establishes no learned-texture mechanism (2026-10-06 wording amendment).
- Row 15, Primary rule (H_B2) at L1, observation quantization: The 2026-07-21 H2 spec names the L1 run (A3) without a rule of its own; the record applies H_B2.
- Row 16, Sensory-echo control, hidden 8: The spec was first committed together with its result, after the run's output was written, so the freeze is commit-simultaneous (as with hidden 7).
- Row 17, Sensory-echo control, hidden 7: Noted 2026-10-10: the spec's "Out of scope" section lists hidden = 7. The rule was frozen for the hidden-8 agents; the 2026-09-29 entry applied it to the hidden-7 agents after that, so this row's rule was not registered for this run before it ran. Passes on its mean basis while the t90 lower bound sits under the bar.
- Row 18, Nonlinear joint input-plus-behavior control, hidden 8: The spec was committed about three minutes after the first cell was written and before the first survival cell. Superseded by the corrected-agent control of FINDINGS 17.8 (0.620, no frozen margin).
- Row 22, Second surrogate instance (seed 1, hidden 10): replication: Gate added 2026-10-10. Read over every drift, arm and seed, the speed positive control is short in one pool of 60 (untrained arm, drift 0.45, seed index 6: 0.748 against 0.75); the figure first recorded, 0.833, was the lowest arm mean. By the rule applied to the white-jitter run, the readings of this run are descriptive. The replication rule was not met in any case, so the outcome does not move.
- Row 23, Hidden 8 at a new surrogate seed (seed 2): replication: The spec header records the freeze on 2026-09-29, the day after the design date.
- Row 27, Auxiliary comparison: C1 meets the primary rule and leads C2 by more than 0.05: Outcome restated 2026-10-10 with the registered result first (PREREGISTRATION_L3 sec. 12, 2026-10-10 entry; artifacts/corrected_verdicts.json, holds false, holds_on_decodability_clauses true). Until then this row read "does not hold; holds on the decodability clauses, conditional on the C1 gates". The lead is +0.120 [+0.065, +0.174] at the 300-update budget; no reading moved.
- Row 30, Texture comparator qd, question 1 (transfer of the original direction): qd failed its gate 0; its untrained floor is outside tolerance, so the spec's amendment makes the survival-minus-untrained margin the comparison that carries meaning.
- Row 31, Texture comparator qd, question 2 (fresh probe): qd failed its gate 0; its untrained floor is outside tolerance, so the spec's amendment makes the survival-minus-untrained margin the comparison that carries meaning.
- Row 33, Drift-0.45 world-sample sensitivity: The registered draw ranks exactly at the bound the rule requires.
- Row 35, Comparator-trained run on the white-jitter family: The survival, predictor and untrained readings are descriptive only and are not a reading of the jitter, because the trunk width differs from every other run.
- Row 36, L1 stream readout: does the agent's own stream carry the seam: The state probe on the same agents reads 0.552 under the explicit partition.
- Row 37, Experiment C emergence under selection: The pooled re-run of 2026-07-18 (FINDINGS 13.D) fails every clause as well. The gate-1 clause reads the runner's verdict, which applies the 0.005 margin of the unratified section-14 draft; frozen section 7 gives gate 1 no number, and against its wording the treatment gap (0.00228, 90% CI [0.00109, 0.00377], control gap 0) is a weak positive. The routing rests on gate 5 (2026-10-10).
- Row 38, Goal and stakes: pellet-touch objective without death meets the primary rule: Touch engagement is the spec's ratio rule: the trained touch return at least 1.5 times the better baseline (1.30 pellets per episode against 0.52).
- Row 40, Goal and stakes: the reading grows with the stakes: The calibration (scripts/calibrate_scarcity.py, artifacts/goal_stakes/calibration.json) chose 24 pellets, the density C1 already uses, so S-scarce would have repeated C1 and was not run. The record gives the survival means descriptively: S-immortal 0.744, C1 0.733.
- Row 41, Comparator-trained run on the white-jitter family, at the registered trunk: The readings are descriptive. Engagement passes in 20 of 20 cells and the speed positive control in 60 of 60 pools.
- Row 42, L3 primary rule at the second capacity, hidden 7, corrected trainer: The clauses are PREREGISTRATION_L3 sections 7 and 8 as the 2026-07-14 entry applied them; the rerun spec, frozen before launch, adds the gate-0 measurement on the run's own fit. Reported beside L3-H7-N10, which keeps its record. The readings are descriptive; the survival arm does not lead the predictor (-0.0001).
- Row 43, Second surrogate instance (seed 1, hidden 10): replication, corrected trainer: The clauses are those of docs/specs/2026-09-26-l3-second-fingerprint-instance-design.md, which the rerun spec applies unchanged. The drift-0 cells are C1's agents, so the L0 reading is C1's. Reported beside L3-H10-GS1-CPU, which keeps its record; its predictor and untrained targets are bit-equal to this run's.
- Row 44, Hidden 8 at a new surrogate seed (seed 2): replication, corrected trainer: The clauses are those of docs/specs/2026-09-28-l3-hidden8-second-seed-design.md, which the rerun spec applies unchanged. The short pool is the untrained arm at drift 0.45, seed index 0. Descriptively the predictor margin fails (+0.031). Reported beside L3-H8-GS2-GPU, which keeps its record.
